categories.main_business_segments: Liaoning Xinde New Material Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery anode coating materials and asphalt-based carbon fiber products. The company also produces by-products such as carbon black raw oil (rubber plasticizer) and cracked naphthalene distillate. It has expanded its business to include downstream asphalt-based carbon fiber manufacturing, forming a comprehensive carbon fiber product system.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technologies in producing anode coating materials based on petroleum pitch and asphalt-based carbon fibers. It employs advanced processes including polymerization, spinning, oxidation, carbonization, graphitization, and purification. The firm emphasizes continuous R&D, with 147 patents including 11 invention patents, and operates integrated production lines with high automation and energy efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic lithium-ion battery anode material manufacturers such as BTR, Putailai, Shanshan, Zhongke Electric, Shangtai Technology, and Kaijin Energy. The end markets served include electric vehicles, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, aerospace, and other industries requiring high-performance lithium-ion batteries and carbon fiber materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in China, with production bases in Dalian (Liaoning Province) and Chengdu (Sichuan Province). It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and the United States, supporting overseas sales and market expansion. Domestic sales account for over 99% of revenue, with a small portion exported internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Liaoning Xinde New Material Technology Group is positioned upstream to midstream in the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on producing critical anode coating materials and raw materials for carbon fiber manufacturing. It sources upstream raw materials like ethylene tar and petroleum resin and supplies downstream battery anode material producers and carbon fiber manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in anode coating materials and asphalt-based carbon fibers, focusing on enhancing product performance for fast-charging and high-rate lithium-ion batteries. It pursues platform-based R&D, expands production capacity, and strengthens collaboration with research institutes and universities. Key R&D projects include developing liquid-state anode coating materials, high-performance asphalt-based carbon fibers, and rubber plasticizers with broader applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithium-ion battery anode coating materials, asphalt-based carbon fiber products, and by-products such as carbon black raw oil and cracked naphthalene distillate. The company operates a direct sales model, serving major battery material manufacturers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in the lithium-ion battery anode coating materials sector, competing with firms like BTR, Putailai, Shanshan, Zhongke Electric, Shangtai Technology, and Kaijin Energy. It holds a strong market position due to its comprehensive product portfolio, technological capabilities, and long-term strategic partnerships with major battery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 810 million, a 14.62% decrease from 2023, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 33 million. Despite short-term profitability challenges due to industry price pressures and inventory adjustments, the company has expanded its anode coating material production capacity to 70,000 tons per year and maintains steady growth in sales volume. It holds total assets of around RMB 3 billion and net assets of approximately RMB 2.69 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Liaoning Xinde New Material Technology Group emphasizes high-quality, stable-performance anode coating materials with a broad range of softening points and high coke values, enabling customized solutions for various battery technologies including fast-charging and silicon-based anodes. Its integrated production capabilities, strong R&D, and cost advantages from upstream raw material integration differentiate it from competitors. The company also leverages its expanding carbon fiber product line to support emerging applications in insulation and composite materials.
